scope: stock module, stock assembly/P-Code/Ghidra body, KCFI and callback-table relocation
candidate C source and callback signature basis
review_findings: The callback ABI, return type, zeroed local input, single I2C read, ignored helper result, nibble extraction and stores, eight ordered snprintf arguments, output length and return match the stock evidence.
The stock decompiler omits the high-nibble vararg for sequences 1, 3, 5 and 7; stock assembly proves w4 contains each value and the candidate supplies it.

All eight automated gates pass in the final map-closure report. Assembly has 105 instructions and 420 bytes with matching relocations; strict normalized C and P-Code comparisons pass without fallback.
The ASan/UBSan harness passes four scenarios and verifies output boundaries and touched haptic bytes. The five MP4 observation IDs are unique.
status_note: The function is PROVEN_OFFLINE_EXACT while map_status remains candidate_under_static_validation. promotion_authorized=false is the protocol runner’s non-promoting decision; no whole-module promotion is authorized.
limitations: KCFI collides for char * and unsigned char *; char * is the best-supported nominal spelling from the stock wrapper.
Physical meaning of register 0x12 and device behavior remain unknown; no hardware validation was performed.
This function-level proof does not establish whole-driver equivalence.
